changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResourceSetting') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResourceSetting]( [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Setting] nvarchar(200) NOT NULL, [Value] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResourceSetting] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( ResourceID ASC, AssetTypeID ASC, Setting ASC ) ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResourceSetting') BEGIN drop table dbo.ResourceSetting END
